title: Newfoundland Nacho Canadian Potatoes Hash
description: A Canadian twist on the classic nacho potatoes hash, made with baby new potatoes, whole30-friendly and served fresh.

ingredients.name: Baby new potatoes
ingredients.notes: Select potatoes of similar size for even cooking

ingredients.name: Avocado oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil for best results

ingredients.name: Chopped onion
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet variety like Vidalia

ingredients.name: Chopped bell pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet variety like bell boy

ingredients.name: Chopped jalapeno
ingredients.notes: Remove seeds and membranes for less heat

instructions: Wash the baby potatoes and pat them dry with paper towels.
Cut the potatoes into 1/2-inch cubes and place them in the preheated cook.
Drizzle the avocado oil over the potatoes and sprinkle with Cattle Ranch seasoning.
Toss the potatoes to coat them evenly with the oil and seasoning.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and jalapeno to the cook and toss to combine.
Cook for 10 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
Add the crumbled bacon to the cook and toss to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the bacon is crispy.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the potatoes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until melted.
Remove the cook from the heat and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Serve the Newfoundland Nacho Canadian Potatoes Hash hot and enjoy!
